title: FDA Takes Further Steps to Remove Outdated Authorizations for Color Additives in Food
excerpt: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration today announced two actions targeting petroleum-based color additives in food, continuing the agency’s broader efforts to Make America Healthy Again.
